name: grigori_horseman
description: a Grigori Horseman, a young rider with curly brown hair under a steel kettle helmet with a gold band, a teal scarf blowing back from his neck, brown leather armour with gold studs and a leather saddlebag, a round teal-and-gold shield with a gold boss on his RIGHT arm and a steel-tipped wooden spear held upright in his LEFT hand, riding a brown horse with a white blaze, a black mane and tail, a brown leather bridle with gold fittings and dark hooves
hands: the spear stays in the rider's left hand on the screen-right side and the round teal-and-gold shield on his right arm on the screen-left side

strike.3: swing: the rider whips forward and brings the spear over the top in an overhand stab, its steel point leading toward the lower-right; the horse plunges forward and down, its forelegs reaching toward the lower-right; both face the lower-right
